harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «نتلو» is resumptive. The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «نتلو». «لقوم» is attached to «نتلو», and the clause «يؤمنون» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «شيعًا»: second object. The clause «يستضعف» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «جعل», and the clause «يذبح» is a badal (substitute) from «يستضعف». The clause «إنه كان» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items, and the preposition «من المفسدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن نمُنَّ» is the object of «نريد». The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استضعفوا». The clause «ونريد أن نمُنَّ» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلا}, a verbal clause conjoined to a nominal one, because both of them are an explanation of the account (al-nabaʾ).

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «نري». «ما»: a relative noun, second object of «نري».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «وأوحينا» is resumptive. «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative. The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أرضعيه», and the clause «إنَّا رادُّوه» is resumptive. The preposition «من المرسلين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of the active participle, i.e. "and making him one of the messengers".

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «فالتقطه» is resumptive. The lām in «ليكون» is that of outcome (lām al-ʿāqiba). The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدوًّا». The clause «إن فرعون..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «وقالت امرأت» is resumptive. «قرت»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو" (he). The preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قرت عين». The clause «لا تقتلوه» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «عسى أن ينفعنا»; the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of the complete (tāmm) «عسى». The clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of an implied verb, i.e. "they obeyed her while they did not perceive what it would lead to".

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «وأصبح» is resumptive. «إنْ» is lightened from the heavy (inna) and inoperative (muhmala); «كادت» is an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa). The clause «إن كادت» is resumptive. «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). «أنْ» is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "were it not that Our binding [of her heart] exists". The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "she would have disclosed it".

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «فبصرت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قالت». The two prepositions «به» and «عن جنب» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «بصرت», and the clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «بصرت».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «وحرّمنا» is resumptive. The preposition «من قبل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حرّمنا». The clause «فقالت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «حرّمنا». The clause «يكفلونه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أهل», and the clause «وهم له ناصحون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يكفلونه».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «كي»: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by an implied lām. The second interpreted maṣdar «ولتعلم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding maṣdar. The interpreted maṣdar formed from أنَّ and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «تعلم». The clause «ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «فرددناه».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «حُكْمًا»: second object. The clause «نجزي» is parenthetical, and the wāw is parenthetical. The kāf is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We reward the doers of good with a reward like that reward".

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «ودخل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the conditional clause, and «على» in the sense of «في» (in) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «دخل». The preposition «من أهلها» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «غفلة», and the clause «يقتتلان» is a naʿt. The clause «هذا من شيعته» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يقتتلان». The clause «فاستغاثه» is conjoined to the clause «وجد». The preposition «مِنْ عدوه» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «إنه عدو» is a ḥāl from «الشيطان».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فاغفر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ظلمت». «هو»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ, and the clause «إنه هو الغفور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The bāʾ is a preposition, of causation, and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "protect me because of Your favour". The implied clause «اعصمني» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «فلن أكون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the implied verb. The preposition «للمجرمين» is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «فأصبح» is resumptive, and the clause «يترقَّب» is a second khabar (predicate) of أصبح. The fāʾ in «فإذا» is a conjunction and «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أصبح». «مبين»: second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The first «أن» is redundant (zāʾida), and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يبطش» is the object of «أراد». The preposition «لهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدوّ». The kāf in «كما» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the implied form is "a killing like your killing of a soul". «إنْ» is negating, and the maṣdar «أن تكون» is the object of «تريد». The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to «جبارًا». The clause «إنْ تريد إلا أن تكون» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The preposition «من أقصى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رجل», and the clause «يسعى» is a naʿt of «رجل». The clause «فاخرج» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إن الملأ يأتمرون بك». The clause «إني لك من الناصحين» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech; the preposition «لك» is attached to «الناصحين».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «يترقب» is a second ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خرج», and the clause «قال» is resumptive. «رب»: one addressed in the vocative, a muḍāf, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the speaker. «نجِّني»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «تلقاء»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. «عسى»: an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and the interpreted maṣdar is the khabar (predicate) of عسى. «سواء»: second object.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ}. The preposition «من الناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أمة», and the clause «يَسْقون» is a naʿt of «أمة». The preposition «من دونهم» is attached to the verb وجد. The clause «تذودان» is a naʿt of «امرأتين». «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خطبكما» is its khabar (predicate), and «ما» is the sign of the dual. The clause «قالتا» is resumptive, and the clause «وأبونا شيخ كبير» is conjoined to the clause «لا نسقي».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «فسقى» is resumptive. The lām in «لما» is a preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive; the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلت». The preposition «من خير» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما», and «فقير» is the khabar (predicate) of «إني».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «فجاءته» is resumptive, and the clause «تمشي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «جاءته». The preposition «على استحياء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «تمشي». «ما» in «ما سقيت» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "the wage of your watering". The clause «فلما جاءه» is resumptive, and «القصص» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «نجوت» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: His words «يا أبت»: one addressed in the vocative, a muḍāf, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which has been replaced by tāʾ; the kasra of the bāʾ was moved to the tāʾ, and the tāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «مَنْ»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. «القوي الأمين»: two khabars (predicates) of «إن». The clause «إن خير ...» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The interpreted maṣdar is the object of «أريد». «هاتين»: a demonstrative, a naʿt (adjective) interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "the two pointed to". The preposition and its genitive noun «على أن تأجرني», which is equivalent to a maṣdar, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent), i.e. "stipulating". «ثماني»: an adverb of time attached to «تأجرني», and the second object of «تأجرني» is omitted, i.e. "yourself". The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl). His words «فمن عندك»: the fāʾ is the linking one (rābiṭa), and the preposition is attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then the completion is from you". His words «عشرًا»: an adverb of time attached to «أتممت», and the tamyīz (specification) is omitted, i.e. "ten years (ḥijaj)", indicated by what precedes it. The clause «ستجدني» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech, and the clause «إن شاء الله» is parenthetical between the two objects of وجد; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «من الصالحين» is attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The adverb «بيني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «أيَّما»: a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the fāʾ after it is the linking one (rābiṭa), and «لا» is the lā of generic negation together with its ism. The clause «قضيت» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech, and the clause «والله وكيل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قضيت». The preposition «على ما نقول» is attached to the khabar «وكيل».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «لما»: a particle of occurrence because of occurrence (wujūb li-wujūb). The preposition «من جانب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نارًا». The two prepositions «منها» and «بخبر» are attached to the verb «آتيكم». The preposition «من النار» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «جذوة». The clause «إني آنست» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech, and likewise the two clauses «لعلي» and «لعلكم».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The two prepositions «من شاطئ» and «في البقعة» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نُودي», and the third preposition «من الشجرة» is a badal (substitute) from «من الشاطئ», a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion). «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause «يا موسى» is explicative. The clause «إني أنا الله» is resumptive, the response to the vocative. «أنا»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun yāʾ. «رب»: badal from the Divine Name. «العالمين»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: His words «وأنْ ألق»: the wāw is a conjunction and «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya). The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ألق». The clause «تهتز» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «رآها», and the clause «كأنها جان» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «تهتز». The clause «ولَّى» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «مدبرا»: ḥāl from the fāʿil of «ولَّى». The clause «يا موسى» is resumptive, and the clause «إنك من الآمنين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «تخرج» is the apodosis of an implied condition. «بيضاء»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تخرج». The preposition «من غير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second ḥāl from the fāʿil of «تخرج», i.e. "being without…". The preposition «إليك» is attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I mean", and it is not attached to «اضمم», because in this category the verb of an attached latent pronoun does not pass over to its own attached pronoun; so one does not say "فرحت بي". The preposition «من الرهب» is attached to «اضمم». The clause «فذانك برهانان» is resumptive, within the scope of the response to the vocative. «من ربك» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «برهان». The demonstrative in His words «فذانك» has been made masculine although what it points to is the hand and the staff, both of which are feminine, because برهان (proof) is masculine and the mubtadaʾ (subject) is identical with the khabar (predicate) in meaning. The preposition «إلى فرعون» is attached to a second naʿt of «برهانان», and the clause «إنهم كانوا» is a ḥāl from «فرعون وملئه».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «فأخاف» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قتلت». «يقتلون»: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The interpreted maṣdar «أن يقتلون» is a mafʿūl bihi.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «وأخي هارون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), and «هارون» is a badal (substitute). The clause «هو أفصح» is the khabar (predicate) of «أخي». The preposition «مني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أفصح». «لسانًا»: tamyīz (specification). «ردءًا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «أرسله», and the clause «يصدِّقني» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ردءًا». The clause «إني أخاف» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The preposition «لكما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and the clause «فلا يصلون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نجعل». The preposition «بآياتنا» is attached to «الغالبون». «مَنْ»: a noun conjoined to «أنتما». «الغالبون»: khabar (predicate) of «أنتما». The clause «أنتما ومن اتبعكما الغالبون» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The preposition «بآياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «موسى», i.e. "bearing". «بينات»: ḥāl from «آياتنا». «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «هذا سحر» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «مفترى» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «وما سمعنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما هذا إلا سحر».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The preposition «بمَنْ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم». «بالهدى» is attached to «جاء», and the preposition «من عنده» is attached to «جاء». «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding «مَنْ», in the position of the genitive. The preposition «له» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «تكون». The clause «إنه لا يفلح» is resumptive, and the hāʾ is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «الملأ»: badal (substitute). «إله»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إله». «غيري»: naʿt (adjective) of «إله»; it did not become definite through the iḍāfa because it is vague (mubham). The clause «فأوقد» is resumptive. The preposition «لي» is attached to the second object. The clause «لعلي أطلع» is resumptive, and the clause «وإني لأظنه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لعلي أطلع». The preposition «من الكاذبين» is attached to the second object. The clause «يا هامان» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «هو»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «استكبر», and «جنوده» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the latent pronoun in «استكبر». The preposition «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) and what is conjoined to it. The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects. The preposition «إلينا» is attached to «يرجعون».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «وجنوده»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ. «كيف»: an interrogative noun, khabar (predicate) of kāna. The clause «فانظر» is conjoined to the clause «نبذناهم», and the clause «كيف كان» is the object of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative and made to include the meaning of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «يدعون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أئمة». The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينصرون», and the clause «لا يُنصرون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يدعون».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «وأتبعناهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «جعلناهم». The preposition «في هذه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «لعنة». The clause «هم من المقبوحين» is conjoined to the clause «أتبعناهم», and the adverb «يوم» is attached to «المقبوحين».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «ولقد آتينا» is resumptive. «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «بصائر»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكتاب». The preposition «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بصائر». The clause «لعلهم يتذكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «وما كنت بجانب» is resumptive. «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the "being" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) of «كانت» is attached, and the clause «قضينا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وما كنت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one: «وما كنت». [Translator's note: the source writes «كانت» here, though the verse has كنت.]

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «ولكنَّا أنشأنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَمَا كُنْتَ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ}, and the clause «فتطاول» is conjoined to the clause «أنشأنا». The clause «وما كنت ثاويًا» is conjoined to the clause «لكنا أنشأنا», and the clause «تتلو» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «ثاويًا». The preposition «في أهل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ثاويًا». The clause «ولكنا كنا مرسلين» is conjoined to the clause «ما كنت ثاويًا».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the "being" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. The wāw is a conjunction, «لكن» is for correction (istidrāk), and «رحمة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) whose governor is omitted, i.e. "We sent you"; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما كنت». The clause «وما كنت» is conjoined to the clause {وَمَا كُنْتَ} in verse (44). The genitive interpreted maṣdar «لتنذر» is attached to the implied «أرسلناك». «نذير»: fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «من قبلك» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «نذير».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «أن» and what follows it are equivalent to a maṣdar, a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "We would not have sent them a messenger". The preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تصيبهم». «لولا أرسلت» is for urging (taḥḍīḍ). The fāʾ in «فنتبع» is causal, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن نتبع» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar taken from the preceding speech, i.e. "why was there not a sending, and so a following of the signs?"

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَلَوْلا أَنْ تُصِيبَهُمْ}. The preposition «من عندنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحق». «لولا» is for urging (taḥḍīḍ). «مثل»: second object. The clause «يكفروا» is resumptive. The preposition «من قبل» is attached to «أوتي», and the preposition «بكل» is attached to «كافرون».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are truthful, then bring…", and this condition is the content of the implied speech. The preposition «من عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب». The clause «أتبعه» is the apodosis of an implied condition. The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {قُلْ}, and the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «علم». The clause «ومَنْ أضل» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أضل» is the khabar (predicate). The preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أضل». The preposition «بغير» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «اتبع». The preposition «من الله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «هدى».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «ولقد وصَّلنا» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «لعلهم يتذكرون».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The relative clause is resumptive. The preposition «من قبله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause «هم يؤمنون» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The preposition «من ربنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحق». The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding resumptive one. The clause «إنه الحق» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «إنا كنا». The preposition «من قبله» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «مسلمين».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «أجرهم»: second object. «مرَّتين»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤتون». The clause «ينفقون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يدرءون», and the preposition «مما» is attached to «ينفقون».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {يُنْفِقُونَ}, and the clause «سمعوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «سلام عليكم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «لا نبتغي الجاهلين» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «ولكن الله يهدي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive «إنك لا تهدي», and the clause «وهو أعلم» is conjoined to the clause «يهدي». The preposition «بالمهتدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «معك»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نتبع». The clause «نتخطف» is the apodosis of a condition (jawāb sharṭ). The clause «أولم نمكن» is resumptive. The clause «يُجبى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حرمًا». «رزقًا»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), synonymous with its governor, because the meaning of «يُجبى إليه» is "He provides for them". The preposition «من لدنا» is attached to a naʿt of «رزقا». The clause of correction (istidrāk) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أولم نمكن».

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The wāw is resumptive. «كم» is the declarative (khabariyya) one, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and the preposition «من قرية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم». «معيشتها» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The clause «فتلك مساكنهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أهلكنا», and the clause «بطرت» is a naʿt of «قرية». The clause «لم تسكن من بعدهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مساكنهم». «قليلا»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "they were not inhabited, of the kinds of inhabiting, except a little inhabiting". The clause «وكنا نحن الوارثين» is conjoined to the clause «لم تسكن», and the linking pronoun is implied, i.e. "of them from them". «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «وما كان ربك مهلك» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «كم أهلكنا», and the genitive interpreted maṣdar «حتى يبعث» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مهلك». The clause «وما كنا مهلكي» is conjoined to the clause «ما كان ربك مهلك». The clause «يتلو» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رسولا», and the clause «وأهلها ظالمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «القرى».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The wāw is resumptive. «ما»: a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a passive past verb, the tāʾ being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The preposition «من شيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما». The fāʾ is the linking one (rābiṭa). «متاع»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو" (it). The wāw in «وما عند الله» is a conjunction; «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and «عند» is an adverb attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «وما عند الله خير» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive «وما أوتيتم», and the clause «أفلا تعقلون» is resumptive. [Translator's note: the source says only "and a passive past verb" without naming it; the verb is «أوتيتم».]

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The clause «أفمن وعدناه» is resumptive, and the clause «فهو لاقيه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila (relative clause) «وعدناه». The preposition «كمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun. «متاع»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «يوم»: an adverb attached to «المحضرين». The clause «ثم هو من المحضرين» is conjoined to the clause «متَّعْنَاه».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يوم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) "اذكر" (remember); the clause "واذكر يوم" is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {أَفَمَنْ وَعَدْنَاهُ}. «أين»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «شركائي»: mubtadaʾ (subject). «الذين»: naʿt (adjective) of شركائي. The two objects of «تزعمون» are implied, i.e. "you claim that they are My partners".

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «هؤلاء الذين» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the pronoun referring back to the relative noun in «أغوينا» is implied, i.e. "أغويناهم" (we misled them). It is not permissible for «الذين» to be a naʿt (adjective) and the clause «أغويناهم» the khabar, because the khabar would then carry no additional information beyond what is in its adjective. His words «كما»: the kāf is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the implied form is "we misled them with a misleading, so they erred with an erring like our erring". «إيانا»: a detached accusative pronoun, an object placed first. The clause «أغويناهم» is resumptive, and likewise the two clauses «تبرَّأنا» and «ما كانوا».

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «فدعَوْهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قيل». The interpreted maṣdar «أن كانوا» is the fāʿil (agent) of (ثبت). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, the implied form being "had their being rightly guided been established, they would not have seen the punishment". The conditional clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: His words «ويوم»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «يوم» that precedes in verse (62). «ماذا»: an interrogative noun, mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). It is not permissible to take its implied form as "ما الذي أجبتم به؟" (what is that with which you answered?) and then that the genitive referring pronoun was omitted, because it would be without the condition for its omission being met.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «فعميت» is resumptive, and the clause «فهم لا يتساءلون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: «فأما»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). «صالحًا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «فعسى أن يكون»: the fāʾ is the linking one (rābiṭa), «عسى» is a complete (tāmm) past verb, and the interpreted maṣdar is its fāʿil (agent). Taking «مَنْ» as relative is preferred over taking it as conditional so that two conditional particles do not come together. The clause «فعسى أن يكون» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «مَنْ».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «وربك يخلق» is resumptive. «سبحان»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar «عمَّا يشركون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعالى», i.e. "He is exalted above their associating". The clause «ما كان لهم الخيرة» is resumptive, and likewise the clause (نسبح سبحان); the clause «وتعالى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نسبح».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «وهو الله» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ربك يعلم». The clause of declaring transcendence [Translator's note: «لا إله إلا هو»] is a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «هو», and the clause «له الحمد» is a third khabar. His words «إلا هو»: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. The preposition «في الأولى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحمد». The clause «ترجعون» is conjoined to the clause «له الحمد».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The first object of «أرأيتم» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to «الليل»; the two verbs «رأيتم» and «جعل» contend (tanāzuʿ) for «الليل», and «جعل» was made to govern because it is closer to it. The two objects of جعل are «الليل سرمدًا». The clause «إن جعل» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, explained by the interrogative clause. The preposition «إلى يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «سرمدا». «مَنْ إله»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). «غير»: naʿt. The clause «مَنْ إله» is the second object of «أرأيتم», and the clause «يأتيكم» is a second naʿt of «إله». The clause «أفلا تسمعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: (قل أرأيتم إن جعل الله عليكم النهار سرمدا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] Like the preceding verse, in its single words and its clauses.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The wāw in «ومِنْ رحمته» is resumptive. The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The interpreted maṣdar «لتسكنوا» is genitive, attached to «جعل», and the second maṣdar is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first maṣdar, i.e. "for resting and for seeking". The clause «ولعلكم تشكرون» is conjoined to the preceding genitive single word, i.e. "and for seeking, and that you may be grateful".

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive, and «يوم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) "اذكر" (remember); the clause «يناديهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «أين»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «شركائي». The two objects of the claiming are omitted, i.e. "you claim that they are partners".

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The clause «نزعنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {يُنَادِيهِمْ}, and the clause «قلنا» is conjoined to the clause «نزعنا». «هاتوا»: an inflexible (jāmid) imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). The interpreted maṣdar «أن الحق لله» stands in place of the two objects of علم. «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, fāʿil.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «فبغى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «كان». The preposition «من الكنوز» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آتيناه». «ما»: a relative noun, second object. «أولي»: naʿt (adjective) of العصبة, genitive with yāʾ. The clause «إن مفاتحه لتنوء» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative. «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to an implied verb, i.e. "he displayed joy when…", and the implied clause is resumptive. The clause «إن الله لا يحب الفرحين» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: His words «فيما»: «في» is causal, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The kāf in «كما» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "do good, a doing of good like Allah's doing of good". The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to the maṣdar (الفساد).

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «إنما»: the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa), having no governing effect. The preposition «على علم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The adverb «عندي» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «علم». The clause «أولم يعلم» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of علم. «قوة»: tamyīz (specification). The clause «ولا يسأل» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: The clause «فخرج» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause {قَالَ}. The preposition «في زينته» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خرج». «ما»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «إنه لذو حظ» is a ḥāl from «قارون».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «العلم»: second object. «ويلكم»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an unused (muhmal) verb. The preposition «لِمَنْ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». «صالحًا»: second object. The clause «ولا يلقَّاها إلا الصابرون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ثواب الله خير»; «الصابرون» is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). [Translator's note: the source calls «صالحًا» a "second object"; in the verse it is the object of «عمل».]

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The clause «فخسفنا» is resumptive, and the fāʾ in «فما» is resumptive. The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna. «فئة»: ism (subject) of kāna, and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «ينصرونه» is a naʿt (adjective). The preposition «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ينصرونه». The clause «وما كان من المنتصرين» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «فما كان له».

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: «مكانه»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the original being "مثل مكانه" (the like of his position). «وي»: a verbal noun of imperfect sense (ism fiʿl muḍāriʿ) meaning "I marvel", and [Translator's note: «كأنّ»] an abrogating particle and its ism. The preposition «من عباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَنْ». «لولا»: a particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), and the interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being "were it not that His favour exists". The conditional clause is resumptive, and likewise the clause «ويكأنه» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: «الدار»: badal (substitute), and the clause «نجعلها» is the khabar (predicate). The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عُلُوًّا». The clause «والعاقبة للمتقين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The clause «فلا يجزى الذين» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); it is a case of putting the overt noun in place of the pronoun, the original being «فلا يجزون». In attributing the doing of evil to them in a repeated form there is extra censure of their state and an increase in making evil hateful in the hearts of the listeners. The technical original is "فهم لا يجزون" (then they are not recompensed), because the negating «لا» is not one of the places of the fāʾ. «ما» in His words «ما كانوا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The lām in «لَرَادُّكَ» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The preposition «إلى معاد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رَادُّكَ». The clause «قل ربي أعلم» is resumptive. «مَنْ»: a relative noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) «يعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «وما كنت» is resumptive. The maṣdar «أن يلقى» is the object of «ترجو». «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). «رحمة»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the exception is from the generality of states. The preposition «من ربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة». The clause «فلا تكونن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «وما كنت»; the verb is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, its ism is the pronoun of the addressee, and «ظهيرًا» is its khabar (predicate). The preposition «للكافرين» is attached to «ظهيرًا».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «بعد»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يصدنَّك». «إذ»: an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: «مع»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إلهًا». The clause of declaring transcendence is resumptive. «إلا هو»: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause «كل شيء هالك» is resumptive. «إلا» is for exception, and «وجهه» is the excepted, accusative. The clause «له الحكم» is resumptive, and the clause «ترجعون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «له الحكم».
